text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Five nearly identical frames of a small white car sitting low in brown water at mid-frame with a faint reflection, rain falling, limestone steps at right. The car is roughly one third of the frame width and its cabin windows are tiny. The sweeping motion is barely visible across 13.0 to 13.8s. Large empty sky above and empty brown water below the caption.
